{{Top|leg}}
The '''MX-Int interdiction mine''' was an [[Gravity mine/Legends|interdiction mine]] produced by [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The MX-Int generated a large [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] when detonated, slowing nearby vessels and reducing their maneuverability.
